title: Calabi-Yau Conjecture for Minimal Hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ with bounded geometry
summary: The Calabi-Yau conjectures for complete minimal hypersurfaces $Σ^{n}\subset \mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ for $n\geq 2$ ask whether a complete minimal hypersurface must be unbounded, and more strongly whether it must be proper. In this work, we resolve this conjecture for complete, connected, embedded minimal hypersurfaces $ Σ^3 \subset \mathbb{R}^4$ with bounded second fundamental form and finite second Betti number $b_2(Σ;\mathbb{Z}_2)<\infty$.
